rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: YanKOR
Exhibition name: Yankee Doodle ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1965).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1977 as 'Yankee Doodle'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow blend. Tea fragrance. 65 to 75 petals. Double (17-25 petals), globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Patents:
New Zealand - Application No: ROS077 on 4 Apr 1979
This PVR Grant application was withdrawn March 7, 1980. United States - Patent No: PP 3,957 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Tate Rose Nursery says this rose has globular shaped bicolor blooms of rich peach-pink to orange sherbert with a yellow reverse...
